// Gaussian blur settings. Radius bounds the kernel extent in pixels; a Sigma
// of 0 or less derives the standard deviation from Radius.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gaussian_blur)
type GaussianBlurParameters
    implements IValue
{
    Radius: Integer;
    Sigma: Number;
